texts.zh:
深海回声定位和地震遥感相结合定位出了[from.GetName]深层振动的源头。其液态氮构成的冰下海洋是一大群巨型鳍脚类动物的家园，它们已经适应了如此严苛的生存环境。

这种引人注目的生物无论是尺寸还是重量都与一艘小型运输舰相当。他们发出强力的低频嗡嗡声来进行交流，这种声音甚至可以在整个行星范围内回荡。一种独特的富含胶原蛋白的鲸脂保护着它们免受低温烧伤和霜冻，同时还能在海洋中放大它们的叫声。

这些巨型动物在这个孤立的生态系统中没有任何天敌，它们非常温顺，通过重复它们独特的声音很容易就能吸引到洋面上。
texts.en:
A combination of deep sea echolocation and seismic telemetry has located the source of the deep vibrations on [from.GetName]. Its subglacial liquid nitrogen ocean is home to vast herds of gigantic pinnipeds who have adapted to life in this harsh environment.

The remarkable creatures have the size and mass of a small transport craft. To communicate, they emit a powerful low-frequency drone that can reverberate on a planetwide scale. A uniquely collagen-rich blubber protects them from cryogenic burns and frostbite, while at the same time amplifying their calls across the sea.

Lacking any natural predators in this isolated ecosystem, these large animals are curious, highly docile, and can be easily drawn to the surface by replicating their idiosyncratic vocalizations.

summary.text:
# 冰下振动 / Subglacial Vibrations

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:220; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:652 (extreme_frontiers.190)

## 如何开始 How it starts

无矿藏的冰冻星球可能生成（3级，权重3，全局一次 max_once_global；需要 has_shroud_dlc；发现者的主物种为机械、或控制者是 AI 时权重为0）。

Can spawn on a frozen planet with no deposit (level 3, weight 3, once globally via max_once_global; needs has_shroud_dlc; weight 0 if the finding leader's main species is robotic or the controller is an AI).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.190“鳍脚巨兽”：选项a（非杀戮帝国）设置国家标志 found_subglacial_pinnipeds、d_society_2 矿藏与每月社会研究加成；选项b（不重视他人的帝国）每月食物加成与 d_food_6 矿藏。

Single result extreme_frontiers.190 "Gigantic Pinnipeds": option a (non-homicidal) sets country flag found_subglacial_pinnipeds, a d_society_2 deposit and monthly society research; option b (empires that do not value others) monthly food and a d_food_6 deposit.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果；选项a/b二选一。

Single outcome; options a/b are alternatives.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

190 的选项a禁止杀戮帝国，选项b只对不重视他人的帝国可见。

190's option a is disallowed for homicidal empires and b is visible only to empires that do not value others.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
